Ведите героя **большим пальцем** в нижне:
Steer the hero with your **thumb** in the lower part of the screen: the stick appears where you touch. Let go and the hero stands still. Every weapon **fires by itself**.

Slain enemies drop **experience gems**. On a new level the game freezes and offers **three cards**: a new weapon, a passive or a level of one you have. Pick with a separate touch; «Reroll» and «Banish» are charges from the workshop, «Skip» gives 15 gold.

A run is **5 minutes**: an elite, «Ring», «Hive», «Wall», and at 4:00 the **Wave Reaper**. Survive and you win. Shards come either way: spend them in the **workshop**.

A maxed weapon with the right passive gives a **fusion** from an elite or boss chest. Each win opens the next **storm level**: angrier enemies, more shards.

Leaving the app pauses and saves the run; it comes back from the same second.
